hunks.baseline: And saw them.

hunks.sol: My acupoints, still not fully healed, screamed. I felt the wounds I’d sustained in the fight, large and small, tearing wider. But there was no other way.

hunks.sol: Like a dragon’s tail stretching out without end.

hunks.sol: *…Damn it.*

hunks.sol: Weakness crawled up my body like a living snake.

hunks.sol: My internal energy, abundant despite its instability, had run dry. My body, which should’ve been resting, cried out in pain from the strain I’d put it through.

hunks.baseline: And on top of that, I was mentally exhausted beyond what I could bear.
hunks.sol: And on top of that came mental exhaustion I could barely bear.
